test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6 Oct 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In March 2022, under the project of setting up health clinics in schools, a health clinic at a government school that will focus on the physical and mental well-being of students was inaugurated in which state of India?
solution:
The correct answer is **Delhi**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• This will be achieved through the joint efforts and close coordination between **Ministry of Health & Family Welfare and Department of School Education and Literacy,** **Ministry of Human Resource and Development at all levels (Centre and State)**.
 
• **Provision of IFA and Albendazole tablets **by teachers through WIFS and NDD programme respectively.
 
• The health promotion activities will be given a special focus.** Age appropriate health education** for the students will be taken up to influence behavior and enhance skills.
 
• At the State level, Coordination Committee will be constituted under the co-chairpersonship of Principal Secretary (s) **Health and Education with Secretaries of Women and Child Development,** Drinking Water and Sanitation, Panchayati Raj and other relevant department as members.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Delhi government on Monday inaugurated **20 ‘Aam Aadmi School Clinics’** as part of a pilot project to focus on the mental well-being and physical health of students.
 
• “A healthy mind will contribute to a healthy society and ultimately a healthier nation. The Aam Aadmi School Clinics consists of **doctors and psychologists** who will listen to the problems of students.
 
• “These clinics will screen **30 students each day** and have an adequate supply of medicines for them.
 
• This** list of medicines has been curated** keeping in mind the specific needs of adolescents, with a primary focus on **anaemia, malnutrition, refractive errors, worm infestation, and menstrual hygiene**,” the government said.
